comparator.name: South and Southeast Asian Studies
comparator.route: Hindi language; Modern South and Modern Southeast Asia specialisation; Leiden third-year programme
comparator.sourceNotes: The selected Hindi/modern thematic/Leiden allocation is arithmetically 60+60+60 and preserves genuine open 15+15 EC. It is diagnostic, not a certified eligible pathway: required Reading South and Southeast Asia demands a prior Area Studies core absent from the current first year, while required shared Philosophy metadata say Dutch despite the formal English-only programme rule. No uncredited prerequisite, waiver or language variant is invented. The named choices are internal selections, not formal graduation specialisations.

routeSelection.basis: The generic target requires a language sequence, a year-two non-language specialisation and a year-three Leiden or study-abroad pathway to instantiate 180 EC. The official programme presents all four regional languages as valid and the two non-language specialisations as alternatives. Hindi and Modern South and Modern Southeast Asia appear first in the current curriculum structure, and the Leiden third-year programme is the first-listed pathway; these choices were made as neutral tie-breaks without reference to UCR fit.

exception.reason: Current sources conflict on an applicable prerequisite and required-module language. The weighted 180-EC allocation is retained only as a diagnostic reconstruction; a coherent eligible pathway is not certified.
